title: Forgiveness of a Chaos Dwarf
start: Speak to Commander Veldaban in the Black Guard headquarters on the western side of Keldagrim.
prereq_quests: Forgettable Tale of a Drunken Dwarf

recommended.t: Ring of Wealth, Ring of Fortune, Luck of the Dwarves, Varrock Teleport runes, Edgeville or Varrock lodestones or spirit tree access to teleport to the Grand Exchange

rewards.t: Access to the Chaos Dwarf Battlefield and the North Keldagrim mining area.
Ability to wield the hand cannon

steps.t: Talk to Commander Veldaban in the building west of the bank in west Keldagrim. [Chat: 3 Do you have a quest for me? › Accept › 2 Do you think the Red Axe is behind it?]
After the cutscene you will be transported next to the Keldagrim Watchtower, continue dialogue with Commander Veldaban. [Chat: 4 I'll deal with the chaos dwarf. › 1 I'm ready.]
Head into the Keldagrim Watchtower next to you, travel upstairs to the roof, and kill the chaos dwarf and pick up the mysterious slip.
Talk to Commander Veldaban about the slip. [Chat: 3 The chaos dwarf dropped a slip of paper. › 1 I'll take the slip to the Grand Exchange now.]
Talk to any Grand Exchange clerk at the Grand Exchange in Varrock. [Chat: 5 I have this dwarven order slip...]

sub.t: Grand Exchange clerks in Prifddinas, the Max Guild, and Menaphos do not work.

If you have never used the Grand Exchange (common for ironmen), the Grand Exchange clerk will refuse to talk to you. Speak to the Grand Exchange Tutor just south and state that "I want the basics from you." before talking to the Grand Exchange clerk.

steps.t: Talk to Veldaban in the Laughing Miner pub in eastern Keldagrim (if he doesn't appear, logout and log back in. In some cases, even after a client restart, he may not appear visually, if this is the case you may click on an invisible Veldaban by clicking on the the northern seat of the most northwestern table in the Laughing Miner pub to speak to him). [Chat: 2 What are you doing here? › 4 Do you think the Red Axe is involved?]
Ask the barmaid for his stout. [Chat: 4 Commander Veldaban wants a Guardsman's Stout. › Any]

Talk to Veldaban about the battle then take him to the headquarters. [Chat: 4 I didn't know you had a lady-friend. › 2 What was the Battle of Barendir? › 1 The barmaid said she'd seen you with someone. › 2 Let's talk about something else. › 1 Are you drunk? › 1 What are you doing here? › 4 Do you think the Red Axe is involved? › 3 Do you think the missing persons are connected to the chaos dwarves? › 2 Who's on the case now? › 1 Why did he take you off the case? › 4 Let's talk about something else. › 3 I have the Grand Exchange package. › 5 Let's talk about something else. › 1 Let's go.]
p: Commander Veldaban is very, very drunk.

steps.t: After the cutscene, head back to the watchtower in the south area of west Keldagrim, where you fought the chaos dwarf.
Open the package and take all the items.
Use the boot on the footprints south of the watchtower building (where you defeated the chaos dwarf).
Follow the footsteps south and then west to reach a small fire pit (the one across the bridge - it looks different from the other fire pits in the area).
p: Covering up the fire at the end of the footprints using the bowl.

steps.t: Use the bowl on the fire pit, remove it, then use the rod on the fire pit.
Turn the rod.
Enter the tunnel west, then enter the doorway at the west end.
Free your hands.
Attempt to ride the train cart (you don't go far).
Leave through the tunnel back to Keldagrim. [Chat: 2 Return to Keldagrim.]
Dismiss any followers you may have.
Talk to Commander Veldaban back where the quest started [Chat: 3 I found a secret door in the mines. › 1 Let's go.] and take him back to the caves.
Try to control the Dwarven Machinery and have Veldaban do it while you ride the cart. [Chat: 3 You take the stones and man the board. I'll ride the cart.]
p: Riding a cart, which feels strangely familiar.

steps.t: Click on the cart to begin.
Follow these choices:
Pull the bridge lever.
Head south to the prison and open the door.
Talk to Fjoila. [Chat: 4 You should get back to Keldagrim now. › 1 You told the prisoner we'd look for Hilda.]
p: Unlocking the door to the Red Axe.
Grunsh brainwashes Brunolt with a spell.

steps.t: Head south, turn either of the switches and go through the doorway. Commander Veldaban may be stuck up north.
p: The meeting between the Consortium directors.

steps.t: Watch the cutscene. [Chat: Any]
After the cutscene, talk to Veldaban in the room. [Chat: Any › 3 That wasn't Hilda. Hilda was gone by then. › 4 There are still some things in the package.]
Use the metal rectangle then the turnscrew on the sorting machine.
Squeeze through the hole and ride the train cart for a cutscene.
Quest complete!

p: Veldaban and the player in the pub.

get_inside.text: First time from the Keldagrim entrance tunnel east of Rellekka.
The Luck of the Dwarves or Hazelmere's signet ring provide unlimited teleports to the west side of the Palace floor 1.

Players with access to Keldagrim can use the Keldagrim trapdoor in the north-west of the Grand Exchange to arrive in East Keldagrim. A luck ring such as the Ring of Wealth or higher variants can also teleport a short distance from the trapdoor using the Grand Exchange teleport option.

The master camouflage outfit provides unlimited teleports to the Consortium (0, 1), the top floor of the palace in the centre of Keldagrim. This allows convenient access to both the east and west side of Keldagrim. Other variants of this outfit will also teleport players to this location five times per day.
Players may buy a one-way rail cart ticket to Keldagrim from one of the cart conductors in the Dwarven Mine under White Wolf Mountain or a free train ride from Dorgesh-Kaan.

Players may also use the Fremennik Province lodestone, run north-east, and enter the cave entrance to the east with two statues. Once inside, there is another entrance with two statues directly in front of the player. Enter this, ignoring the long path.

Players who have level 99 in at least one skill, or are able to wear the Quest Cape can tune the skill portal in Max Guild to the Lava Flow Mine. The portal will teleport the player right next to the entrance to the city. It requires completion of King of the Dwarves.
